profile_text.body:
Snowflake is a for-profit public company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Bozeman, MT, that describes itself as operating an AI Data Cloud designed to support data engineering, analytics, application development, and AI workloads within a unified, scalable platform. The company's site says its infrastructure handles the full data lifecycle, from ingestion and processing through modeling and application sharing, and positions the platform as eliminating data silos for organizations seeking to collaborate and build AI-powered applications. Customers mentioned on the site include Under Armour, Booking.com, and Landing AI.

Snowflake's two tracked AI products are Snowflake Arctic, an enterprise-focused large language model released under an Apache 2.0 license with integration into the data cloud for commercial use, and Snowflake Cortex, a native AI layer within the data cloud offering LLM functions, vector search, data residency controls, and governance features delivered through Snowflake Horizon. The site also references Snowflake Postgres as a recent addition bringing a relational database capability directly into the AI Data Cloud without requiring separate data pipelines.

Snowflake trades on a public exchange under the ticker SNOW with CIK 0001640147. Its most recent annual filing, a 10-K covering the period ending January 31, 2026, reported revenue of approximately $4.68 billion. No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts.
